lines.zh: 我挪一步，地上就陷一块。
lines.en: One step and the ground dents.
An iron body does not walk quickly.
I drag my base forward.
Every step comes with a clang.

lines.zh: 我压着草，草就起不来了。
lines.en: The grass I press does not rise again.
I shift onto flat ground.
I walk this path and the soil packs hard.
I do not detour. I go through.
I scrape a stone and sparks fly.
Each step leaves a deep print.
This heavy, even turning is work.
I slide along, slowly.
I stand there, and I am iron.
Will someone strike me?
My horn is flat.
Sun and rain leave me unchanged.
I carry many old marks.
I have no mouth and no eyes.
The wind blows the dust off me.
Standing like this could last ages.
Iron left alone grows cold.

lines.zh: 我在等一句用得上的话。
lines.en: I wait for a word worth using.
The earth beneath me is pressed solid.
Someone has lit a fire beside me.
I make no sound at all.
A leaf fell on me.

lines.zh: 你站过来，正好和我一样高。
lines.en: Stand here and you are just my height.
Do you mean to use me?
This face is for striking.
What you hold is not light.
I am here. I have always been here.
If you would strike, then strike.
I have no name.

lines.zh: 你要的东西，可能不在我身上。
lines.en: What you seek may not be in me.

lines.zh: 我看着你，虽然我没有眼。
lines.en: I regard you, though I have no eyes.
I know that raised-hand posture.
Strike. I am waiting for the echo.
Have you heard my voice?

lines.zh: 你想把我搬走？搬不动的。
lines.en: Move me? You cannot.
I am older than your house.
This ground is too soft for me.
You and I are much alike.
Then let it be.
A chip came off my horn.
I rang out, and it sounded wrong.
Considerable force, that.
I rocked, but did not fall.
Something has cracked.
Another mark on me.
Another blow and I will warp.
I heard myself hum.
I keep that blow in the iron.
Why give me anything?

lines.zh: 你放我旁边的，我拿不了。
lines.en: I cannot take what you set beside me.

lines.zh: 那是给我用的，不是给我吃的。
lines.en: That is for using, not for eating.
You hold it up, and I can do nothing.
Set it down. Too heavy.
I have no hands to take it.
Keep it for yourself.
All I want is one strike.
That thing is more useful than I am.
You hit me. The pain is yours.

lines.zh: 我的角会磕伤你的膝盖。
lines.en: My horn will bruise your knee.

lines.zh: 你推，我用整个身子顶着。
lines.en: Push, and my whole weight answers.
We struck and rang out.
My base is set in the earth.
Go around.
You have given half a step.
That one you should remember.
I take no part in such things.
I am iron, not living.
That one beside me is iron too.
Set side by side, we are enough.
Someone will come to use us.
There are no words between us.
Two pieces of iron, leaning together.
Rust will come, slowly.

lines.zh: 这是陪伴的另一种样子。
lines.en: This is another kind of company.
Silence is also an answer.
I cannot pick anything up.
Set it on top of me.

lines.zh: 这上面，落下过很多东西。
lines.en: Many things have rested on me.
I hold it up. It will not fall.
Someone forgot to take it.
I cannot remember whose it was.
It rests on my horn, just right.
A gust slides it off.
I bear it with my whole face.
If you want it, take it.
You came close. I know.
Has someone come with a hammer?
On this patch of ground, only you and I.
You have raised a hammer.
That blow will ring a long time.
The anvil lands. One clang is enough.
Strike hard. I will bear it.
I neither dodge nor could I.
I wait for that one sound.
Come. Strike once.
This face is the front.
Aim before you bring it down.
I have waited a long while for this.
Let the hammer fall.
I can take it.
This sound will carry.
You are still there. I am watching.
My iron face is toward you; do not strike.
Your aim is off.
A little higher.
That will chip the horn.
I wait while you adjust.
I will not rush you.
Iron has no fear of blows.
The more you hesitate, the worse your aim.
I am set.
This face toward you is right.
My position will not change.
How many times will you strike?
I can wait indefinitely.
Bring it down.
I hear the wind of it.
One blow will do.
Say when it is done.

lines.zh: 你敲在我角上，回声很长。
lines.en: You struck my horn; the echo lingers.
That blow left the iron warm.
Sparks leap onto your hand.
My voice strikes the surroundings.
A notch appears in the horn.
You put good force into that.

lines.zh: 再来一次，试试别的地方。
lines.en: Again, try another spot.
My base did not move.
Hit harder.
Iron always sounds honest.
That sound carried far.
Did you think I was striking back?
I only give the force back.
That is enough.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用整块身子接的。
lines.en: I took that with my whole body.
I drop and the earth sinks.
An anvil belongs in a smithy.
What place is this?
There is still ash on me.
I must set my footing first.
No fire here, and no one.
I landed with a ring.
The wind crosses my horn.

lines.zh: 我是个物件，被挪了地方。
lines.en: I am an object, moved elsewhere.
No one comes to use me.
I press my base into the soil.
It is quiet here.

lines.zh: 我听见鸟儿落在我上头。
lines.en: A bird has landed on me.

lines.zh: 我等第一个来找我的人。
lines.en: I wait for the first one to come.
Iron does not die, and does not leave.
I will stay here.
The ground is soft; I have sunk a little.
I am in no hurry at all.

lines.zh: 火烤得我发烫，颜色都变了。
lines.en: The fire heats me until my color changes.
The water rises and I begin to rust.

lines.zh: 炸得我飞起来，又重重落地。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, and I land hard.

lines.zh: 有什么东西嵌进我这面里。
lines.en: Something is lodged in this face.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的铁嗡嗡作响。
lines.en: This force sets my iron humming.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具铁也在耗。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet even this iron wears down.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我下去，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning runs down me and I glow.

lines.zh: 铁砧也会落，落到哪算哪。
lines.en: Even an anvil falls; wherever it lands is fine.
